question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Jargon
solution:
The correct answer is "**Slang.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Jargon means specialized language that is used by a particular group or profession**.(शब्दजाल)

 
 
• Example: The computer programmer used a lot of jargon.
 
 
 
• **Slang also refers to informal language used by a specific group or community**.(बोलचाल की भाषा)
 
 
• Example: People addressed each other using their first names and used slang.
 
 
 
 
 
• Both words have a similar meaning and can be used interchangeably in certain contexts.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (**Verboseness**) means using too many words or being excessively wordy.(शब्दाडंबरपूर्णता)
 
• Option 3 (**Formality**) means the level of seriousness or adherence to rules and regulations.(औपचारिकता)
 
• Option 4 (**Eloquence**) means the ability to speak or write in a persuasive and articulate manner.(सुवक्ता )
